title: Chaliapin’s Prophet across the microphone divide
question: How does the same bass reshape Rimsky-Korsakov’s song between acoustic and electrical recording?
intro: Chaliapin recorded this Pushkin setting with Percy Pitt in 1921 and Albert Coates in 1927. The 1927 side was first published in 1928 and is used on territorial European public-domain grounds; US recording status is unestablished. The map compares 0:04–3:44 in 1921 with 0:04–4:19 in 1927, omitting lead-in and residual noise. It is less certain around 2:54–2:55 of the earlier side, and recording technology cannot be isolated from conductors, interpretation and transfer choices.
